# ID — Identity and trust

- Owner: `ticonnect-core`
- Stage: 3
- Layer: `services`
- Component graph: [generated/components/id.md](generated/components/id.md)

## Purpose

Create and store Ed25519 identity, derive fingerprints and node IDs, bind certificates, and own trust CRUD and revocation.

## Boundary

Owns identity key material and trust decisions. Uses storage for peer rows. Never exposes private keys over IPC or logs.

## Owned state

- identity.key
- trusted peer table

## Invariants

- `INV-CFG-1` — Configuration lives only in config.toml and SQLite stores no configuration. Test: crates/settings/src/tests.rs and crates/daemon/tests/storage.rs
- `INV-STAGE-1` — Every stage demo uses only components from that stage or earlier stages. Test: cargo xtask systems --check

## Failure semantics

- refuse world-readable key
- pin mismatch aborts handshake
- revocation closes sessions

## Open decisions

- node id is UUIDv7 stored in identity.toml
- certificate fingerprint versus identity fingerprint
